name_zh: 利奥波德二世/比利时/刚果/殖民/橡胶/暴行/非洲分割/比属刚果
description_zh: 利奥波德二世 (1835-1909) 比利时国王，以个人名义占有刚果自由国，橡胶采集强迫劳动导致千万刚果人死亡，1884-1885年柏林会议主导非洲分割，私人殖民模式成为帝国主义极致暴行代名词，1908年国际压力迫使移交比利时国家。
description_en: Leopold II (1835-1909) Belgian king, personally owned Congo Free State, rubber extraction forced labor caused millions of Congolese deaths, 1884-1885 Berlin Conference led Scramble for Africa, private colonial model became imperialist extreme atrocity synonym, 1908 international pressure forced transfer to Belgian state.
reason_zh: 利奥波德二世代表殖民主义如何通过私人企业形式实现国家暴力的私有化，展示了橡胶经济如何以人命为代价支撑欧洲工业革命，其刚果暴行成为殖民罪行历史清算的永恒标杆，比属刚果遗产延续至今。
reason_en: Leopold II represents how colonialism privatizes state violence through private enterprise form, demonstrating how rubber economy cost millions of lives fueling European industrial revolution, his Congo atrocities becoming colonial crimes historical accountability eternal benchmark, Belgian Congo legacy continuing today.
steps_zh: 研究利奥波德早年王位/比利时建国/殖民野心/亨利·莫顿·斯坦利
分析1884柏林会议/刚果自由国/橡胶配额/断手惩罚/千万死亡
探讨卡斯门蒂报告/莫雷尔运动/国际人道主义干预/1908移交
评估刚果暴行/橡胶经济/私人殖民/历史清算/比属刚果遗产
总结刚果殖民/橡胶暴行/非洲分割/私人殖民/历史清算五重遗产
steps_en: Study Leopold early kingship/Belgium founding/colonial ambition/Stanley
Analyze 1884 Berlin Conference/Congo Free State/rubber quota/hand cutting/millions dead
Explore Casement Report/Morel campaign/international humanitarian intervention/1908 transfer
Evaluate Congo atrocities/rubber economy/private colonization/historical accountability/Belgian Congo legacy

expected_zh: 理解殖民主义如何通过私人企业实现暴力私有化，掌握橡胶经济以人命为代价的运作逻辑，评估利奥波德刚果暴行对殖民史清算与当代比属刚果遗产的双重警示。
expected_en: Understand how colonialism privatizes violence through private enterprise, grasp rubber economy operating logic costing millions of lives, evaluate Leopold Congo atrocities dual warning for colonial history accountability and contemporary Belgian Congo legacy.

case_en: 1885 Congo Free State; 1908 transfer to Belgium; 1909 death. Congo colonization/rubber atrocities/private colonization/historical accountability paradigm endures.
